def solve(inp):
    R,C=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cells8=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if inp[r][c]==8]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells8); c0=min(c for r,c in cells8)
    pat=sorted((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells8)
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            cs=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in pat]
            if all(0<=rr<R and 0<=cc<C and inp[rr][cc] in (0,8) for rr,cc in cs):
                for rr,cc in cs: out[rr][cc]=8
    return out
pred=solve(inp)
print(pred==out)
